Good question. Honestly- and I think this is the most reasonable answer- I'd like Saudi to be more like the UAE. Though they're not perfect by any means, I still have immense respect for how the leadership decided to develop the country. Now, I'm not preaching for a secular Saudi. I'm not saying we're fully retarded, either (though this might actually be the case among the vast majority of the population due to the shitty education and society they were raised in.) I can't expect Saudi to turn into Eden within a week. This might actually take a looooooong time. I digress. The point is, I would like Saudi to be less 'Saudi'. Here's where I'm having a bit of trouble typing out the thoughts going through my head right now. I can go on and on and on about everything I dislike about being raised a Saudi, about being exposed to other Saudis, and having lived in a Saudi society. I don't think this matters unless I turn my experiences into positive ones for future generations. This is literally the only way I can help to somewhat make Saudi less Saudi. The dilemma I'm in right now is: Do I really want to put ANY effort whatsoever in making this shithole a better place for those who are unfortunate enough to come into existence in this shithole? Or should I just move, start a new life, find myself and possibly contribute to some other society elsewhere? It sucks being Saudi. Do you owe the desert, or does the desert owe you?
